title: Refraction Bench
caption: A straw breaks in water; a glass ball flips the arrows
blurb: A straw in a glass of water, a glass block in front of stripes and a glass ball in front of a card of arrows, set out like the optics page of a school book. Every ray bends at each surface it crosses, so the straw breaks at the water line and the ball shows the arrows upside down; set the index to 1.0 and the glass disappears.

controls.does: moves the camera in on it; again to step back
makes the block and the ball glass, diamond, air or water
swings the block and moves the straw round the glass
steps the camera through the pieces
